THE PINK PAINT CLASSROOM CHAOS — KOREAN SCHOOL COMEDY

Duration: 30.6 seconds
Aspect Ratio: 16:9

Style: Photorealistic Korean live-action school comedy, cinematic slapstick, realistic physical action.

1. CHARACTER REFERENCE AND CONSISTENCY

Main Girl — Black-haired Student

A young adult Korean female student with shoulder-length straight black hair, soft bangs, and a calm expression. She wears a beige school blazer with a school emblem, a navy V-neck sweater vest, a white collared shirt, a burgundy necktie, a dark navy plaid pleated skirt, white socks, and black loafers.

She carries a light peach-colored drink cup with a green lid and straw. Throughout the chaotic scene, she remains surprisingly calm and keeps drinking her beverage.

Preserve her exact face, black hairstyle, beige blazer, navy vest, tie, skirt, and drink cup in every shot.

Second Girl — Long Brown-haired Student

A young Korean female student with long straight chestnut-brown hair. She wears a white collared shirt with a large dark plaid bow, a dark plaid pleated skirt, white knee-high socks, and black school shoes.

Initially she looks playful and mischievous. During the prank, her white shirt, hair, and body become covered in bright pink paint. Her appearance gradually changes into a completely pink, paint-covered student.

Male Student — Blond-haired Boy

A young Korean male student with short bleached-blond hair, wearing a beige school blazer, navy sweater vest, white shirt, dark tie, and dark trousers. His face and clothing become covered in bright pink paint during the chaos.

Other Students

Several Korean male and female students in matching beige school blazers, navy sweaters, white shirts, ties, and dark plaid skirts or trousers. They watch, laugh, react, and become involved in the classroom chaos.

2. LOCATION AND ENVIRONMENT

A large Korean school art classroom with:

- Green-painted floor.
- Large wooden worktables and wooden chairs.
- Whiteboard at the front.
- Large windows allowing natural daylight.
- Art easels and painting equipment.
- A classroom entrance with double doors.
- Large paint containers and buckets.
- Brushes, art supplies, and scattered classroom materials.

Bright pink paint spreads across the green floor during the incident. Wooden furniture is moved and overturned during the chaos.

Maintain the same classroom architecture, windows, doors, furniture, and lighting throughout.

3. SHOT-BY-SHOT SEQUENCE

SHOT 1 — 0–1.5 SECONDS: THE MISCHIEVOUS GIRL

Begin with a close-up of the long brown-haired Korean schoolgirl wearing a white shirt and large dark plaid bow.

She stands inside the art classroom, smiling mischievously and covering part of her mouth with one hand as if trying not to laugh.

Other students are visible out of focus behind her. Use a shallow-depth-of-field cinematic close-up.

SHOT 2 — 1.5–3 SECONDS: THE TRAP AT THE DOOR

Cut to a rear wide shot of the classroom entrance.

The black-haired girl wearing a beige school blazer and navy sweater vest walks toward the doorway while calmly drinking from her peach-colored cup through a straw.

A large metal bucket filled with bright pink paint is positioned above the entrance. As she approaches and passes underneath, the bucket begins to fall and tilt.

Show the bucket moving downward above the doorway while the girl continues holding her drink.

SHOT 3 — 3–5 SECONDS: THE PINK PAINT EXPLOSION

Cut to a low-angle shot from inside the classroom.

The pink paint bucket falls and spills its contents dramatically. Bright pink paint splashes across the green classroom floor and nearby students.

The long brown-haired girl and other students react with shock. One student crouches and another falls backward. A large puddle of pink paint spreads across the floor.

Show the bucket tumbling through the air and the pink liquid splashing realistically.

SHOT 4 — 5–7 SECONDS: THE CALM GIRL

Cut to a close-up of the black-haired girl holding her peach-colored drink.

She stands completely calm, takes another sip through the straw, and looks forward with a neutral expression.

She says casually:

"You're welcome."

Keep the English subtitle exactly as shown in the reference style.

The pink paint-covered classroom remains softly visible behind her.

SHOT 5 — 7–10 SECONDS: THE PINK-PAINTED GIRL REACTS

Cut to a close-up of the long brown-haired girl.

Her white school shirt is splattered with bright pink paint, including her shoulder, chest, and hair.

She looks down at the paint on her uniform, then raises her face and shouts angrily with an exaggerated comedic expression.

Her long brown hair and plaid bow remain recognizable despite the paint.

SHOT 6 — 10–13 SECONDS: THE PINK-FACED BOY

Cut to a medium action shot.

A blond-haired male student with his face covered in bright pink paint suddenly charges forward inside the classroom.

The black-haired girl quickly ducks and moves out of his way while still holding her drink cup.

The boy's arms extend outward as he loses control of his movement. Nearby wooden tables and chairs are pushed and disturbed.

Use fast but readable physical comedy.

SHOT 7 — 13–17 SECONDS: CLASSROOM FIGHT AND CHAOS

A wider shot reveals the classroom in complete disorder.

The black-haired girl dodges an approaching student. Another student is knocked backward onto a wooden table, causing it to slide and tip.

Bright pink paint covers a large section of the green floor. Students run and stumble around the room.

The girl continues moving through the chaos while holding her peach-colored drink.

Maintain clear positions and realistic physical movement.

SHOT 8 — 17–20 SECONDS: STUDENTS COLLIDE

Cut to a wide shot near the center of the classroom.

Two female students in beige school blazers and dark plaid skirts collide while struggling with each other. Their feet slide through the pink paint.

One student loses her balance and falls. Their skirts and white socks move naturally during the fall.

Other students react from behind the desks.

SHOT 9 — 20–23 SECONDS: THE BLACK-HAIRED GIRL WATCHES

Cut to a medium shot of the black-haired girl standing near the classroom entrance.

She casually drinks from her peach-colored cup while watching the long brown-haired girl covered in pink paint.

The pink-haired-looking student is down on the floor beside a fallen metal paint container. Bright pink paint is spread across the floor and her clothes.

The black-haired girl remains completely calm.

SHOT 10 — 23–27 SECONDS: THE SAME HAIR COLOR JOKE

Cut to a low-angle medium close-up.

The pink-paint-covered girl is sitting or kneeling on the floor, her long hair completely coated in bright pink paint.

The black-haired girl stands beside her, holding her drink in one hand.

She gently picks up a strand of her own black hair with the other hand and compares it with the pink-painted girl's hair.

She says:

"Wow, our hair's the same color."

Display the English subtitle in the same style as the reference video.

The pink-covered girl looks upward at her while the black-haired girl remains expressionless and casually drinks.

SHOT 11 — 27–30.6 SECONDS: THE FINAL CLASSROOM CHAOS

The black-haired girl calmly walks toward the classroom exit, still holding her drink.

Behind her, the pink-painted girl remains on the floor surrounded by bright pink paint.

Cut to a wide view of the entire classroom. Several students and male classmates are now down on their knees, their hands touching the pink paint spread across the floor.

Some students are covered in pink paint, and the classroom furniture is scattered around.

End with a wide cinematic shot showing the pink-covered classroom, the students kneeling in the mess, and the black-haired girl remaining calm.

4. VISUAL EFFECTS AND PHYSICAL DETAILS

The bright pink paint must look thick, wet, glossy, and realistic.

Show:

- Pink paint splashing from the falling bucket.
- Paint spreading across the green floor.
- Pink stains appearing on uniforms, hair, and faces.
- The metal bucket rolling across the floor.
- Wooden tables and chairs moving during the chaos.
- Realistic slipping, falling, and recovering movements.

Do not turn the paint into magical energy or supernatural effects.

5. CAMERA AND CINEMATOGRAPHY

Use photorealistic Korean school-comedy cinematography.

- Close-up of the mischievous brown-haired girl.
- Rear wide shot of the classroom entrance.
- Low-angle shot of the falling paint bucket.
- Close-up of the black-haired girl drinking.
- Facial close-up of the pink-covered girl.
- Dynamic medium shots during the classroom chaos.
- Wide shots showing students and furniture.
- Final low-angle comparison of black and pink hair.
- Wide concluding classroom shot.

Use natural daylight from the classroom windows, realistic skin textures, natural hair movement, accurate liquid physics, and cinematic depth of field.

6. AUDIO AND DIALOGUE

Include:

- Quiet classroom ambience.
- Bucket falling and metal impact.
- Loud pink paint splashing.
- Students gasping, laughing, and shouting.
- Footsteps and sliding shoes on wet paint.
- Wooden desks and chairs moving.
- The black-haired girl's calm dialogue: "You're welcome."
- Final dialogue: "Wow, our hair's the same color."

Preserve these two English lines exactly. No additional narration.

7. STRICT NEGATIVE PROMPT

No zombies, no meteors, no fantasy powers, no blue lightning, no guns, no weapons, no outdoor scenes, no changing classroom layout, no changing school uniforms, no changing character identities, no changing black-haired girl's hairstyle, no changing brown-haired girl's hairstyle, no random hair colors, no additional main characters, no duplicated students, no extra limbs, no distorted faces, no cartoon style, no anime style, no random text, no watermark.

FINAL OUTPUT: A coherent 30.6-second photorealistic Korean school-comedy video. Reproduce the exact progression: mischievous brown-haired girl, black-haired girl entering with her drink, pink paint bucket falling at the classroom entrance, pink paint spreading across the floor, the calm girl saying "You're welcome," the paint-covered students becoming involved in a chaotic classroom fight, the black-haired girl comparing her hair with the pink-covered girl's hair and saying "Wow, our hair's the same color," and the final wide shot of the pink-covered classroom and students on the floor.

entries.prompt:
生成一条完整的15秒、16:9横屏、真人电影级武打动作短片。

第一帧已经处于交手中，没有片头、走路、对峙或摆造型。
全程实时速度，无慢动作、无定格、无动作回放。
高密度近身攻防，包含闪避、格挡、短拳、肘击、蹬踢与失衡倒地。双方主动进攻、都会受击，不站着等待对方出招。
前半段主角被压制，中段夺掉对方武器，后半段连续反击。
采用10个紧密衔接的镜头，切镜落在动作过程中，但关键接触和受力结果必须清楚。

【角色】
主角：约三十岁的成年东亚男性，短黑发，身材精干，真实皮肤和自然面容。穿米白色棉质短袖、黑色宽松训练长裤、黑色平底训练鞋。衣服有汗湿痕迹，动作短促有力，空手。

对手：约三十五岁的成年东亚男性，体型略高壮，寸头，穿深蓝色短袖训练服、深灰长裤、深色平底鞋，右手握一根约六十厘米的深棕色木棍。

全片只有这两个成年人，以米白和深蓝服装明确区分身份。面容、服装、身材和武器始终一致。

【场景】
白天的旧武馆，宽阔训练区域，深色木地板，浅灰墙面。
画面左侧有一根粗木柱，后方墙边有一条矮木凳，两件物体从开场就能辨认。
大窗位于画面左后方，柔和日光照入，人物面部清楚，木材与棉布质感真实。
战斗始终发生在同一区域，不换场景，不增加观众。
摄影机保持在交战轴线同一侧，不突然颠倒人物方位。

【分镜】

镜头1（0–1.5秒）：
侧面中景。第一帧对手已经挥棍横扫，主角低头闪过，木棍击中后方粗木柱，产生短促木质撞击声。双方脚步继续移动，不停下来摆架势。

镜头2（1.5–3秒）：
短距离跟拍中景。对手收棍贴近，用左肩撞开主角的防守。主角被迫退开一步，鞋底摩擦木地板，立即重新抬臂防守，不夸张飞出。

镜头3（3–4.5秒）：
侧面中景。对手再次举棍下击，主角向持棍手臂外侧移步，避开棍身，同时贴近对方，阻止他重新拉开挥棍距离。

镜头4（4.5–6秒）：
腰部以上中近景，保留双方手臂。主角控制对手持棍前臂，将其压向已出现的木柱。撞击后对手松手，木棍落地滑到柱脚。主角没有接棍，双方进入空手交锋。

镜头5（6–7.5秒）：
侧面中景。对手左拳迎面打来，主角用前臂格开，立即一记短拳击中对手身体。接触后对手腹部收紧，退半步，但仍保持防守。

镜头6（7.5–9秒）：
切稍近的双人中景。对手趁主角收拳，一记短拳打中主角脸侧。主角头部小幅偏转、脚步后撤，迅速找回重心，不长时间摇头或停顿。

镜头7（9–10.5秒）：
侧向跟拍中景。对手追击挥拳，主角低身避开，同时贴近，一记短肘击中对手躯干，迫使他收紧身体。动作紧凑，不大幅旋转。

镜头8（10.5–12秒）：
侧面全身景。主角趁对手后退，一记腰部高度的正面蹬踢击中对方身体。先接触、再后退，对手连续退两步，主角及时收腿落地，没有飞踢或悬空停留。

镜头9（12–13.5秒）：
稳定中全景。对手背部撞到后方墙边矮木凳，凳子在碰撞后滑移，他失去平衡，臀部先落坐、随后侧倒在木地板上，暂时无法继续进攻。主角停在安全距离，不追加攻击。

镜头10（13.5–15秒）：
主角面部近景，背景仍能辨认倒地对手。主角保持防守，胸口起伏，额前有汗，眼睛盯住对手确认威胁结束。最后一秒直接收束，不整理衣服、不摆胜利姿势、不切黑。

【动作与摄影】
真实武打电影摄影，不是游戏动画，不是演武套路。
每次攻击都有起势、接触、回收，每次受击都有符合力度的身体反应。
人物脚步踩实地面，移动有惯性，不瞬移、不滑行漂浮。
保留中景和全身景看清动作，不把每次击打都切成手脚特写。
撞击时允许轻微摄影机震动，但主体始终可辨。
木棍落地后一直留在柱脚，不重新出现在任何人手中。
木柱不被普通拳脚打断，木凳只滑动倾倒，不夸张爆碎。
无完整空翻、无高空旋转、无超能力，无血腥或伤口特写。

【声音】
第一秒即有同步的挥棍与木柱撞击声。
鞋底摩擦、短促拳脚接触、衣料拉扯、木棍落地和木凳滑移与画面准确对应。
配乐采用节奏紧凑的大鼓与低音乐器，不盖住接触声。
第12秒最后反击达到峰值，结尾音乐收轻，留下急促呼吸。
无对白，无旁白，无字幕，无文字，无Logo，无水印。

Every original camera angle must correspond to the same coherent environment. Walls, floors, doors, furniture, vehicles, props, and architectural features must maintain consistent placement, appearance, scale, and orientation whenever visible from different angles.

Do not independently invent a background for each shot. Do not create unrelated environments that happen to share a similar color palette.

Use the original video's spatial information to maintain continuity. Where the source does not reveal a particular part of the location, keep the unseen area simple and neutral rather than inventing elaborate architecture or distinctive set design.

Only reconstruct environmental information that is necessary to make the existing shots physically coherent. Do not use unseen areas as an opportunity to add new visual concepts.

The result must feel as though all the original performances were filmed in one understated location, using exactly the same camera coverage and editing structure as the source.

CAMERA AND EDITING CONTINUITY

Preserve the original video's temporal structure and cinematic camera behavior.

Match the original:

Shot order and edit timing

Shot duration and transition timing

Camera movement and movement speed

Framing, shot scale, and composition

Camera-to-subject distance

Camera angle, perspective, and lens character

Focus behavior, depth of field, and motion blur

Character screen position and spatial relationships

Retain the original camera choreography even when rebuilding the environment.

Do not add new cuts, slow motion, speed ramps, artificial zooms, camera shakes, or transitions that are absent from the source.

Do not freeze, skip, repeat, or arbitrarily extend moments.

Where the new environment requires reconstructed visual elements, adapt the background and set geometry around the preserved camera path.

Maintain consistent spatial continuity across all shots.

FULL CINEMATIC LIVE-ACTION QUALITY

The finished result must have the visual quality and emotional credibility of a professionally directed, fully photographed music video.

AESTHETIC DIRECTION:

Early-2000s music-video atmosphere, authentic hip-hop visual culture, confident and distinctive art direction, tactile photographic textures, cinematic lighting, rich but controlled color, natural imperfections, and a strong sense of physical presence.

Use a coherent combination of:

Filmic highlight roll-off and natural shadow detail

Organic 35mm-film-inspired grain

Realistic skin texture, pores, and fine facial detail

Natural skin tones without artificial smoothing

Physically plausible lighting, reflections, and shadows

Realistic lens rendering, depth of field, and motion blur

Subtle optical imperfections where appropriate

Authentic material textures in clothing, hair, skin, vehicles, and surroundings

Carefully controlled contrast and cinematic color grading

A tactile, slightly imperfect, early-2000s music-video finish

The exact color palette should remain compatible with the source video's mood while being reinterpreted for the new environment.

Avoid excessive digital sharpness, sterile perfection, artificial HDR, exaggerated clarity, and overly processed colors.

ANTI-PLASTIC / ANTI-AI QUALITY LOCK

The result must look photographed, not synthetically rendered.

Absolutely avoid:

Plastic, waxy, rubber-like, or porcelain skin

Excessive skin smoothing or beauty-filter effects

Artificial facial symmetry

Unnaturally glossy faces or lips

CGI-like hair, skin, clothing, or environments

Uncanny eyes, inconsistent pupils, or artificial eye reflections

Warped anatomy, malformed hands, extra fingers, or disappearing limbs

Facial identity drift or unstable facial proportions

Flickering textures, crawling details, or inconsistent clothing

Melting objects, background deformation, or unstable geometry

Floating feet, sliding contact points, or incorrect body weight

Fake reflections, incorrect shadows, or inconsistent lighting

Visible face-swap boundaries, masks, seams, halos, or compositing artifacts

Unmotivated lens flares, glow, particles, glitch effects, or excessive bloom

Preserve natural microtexture and physically plausible imperfections.

Skin must retain realistic pores, subtle tonal variation, and natural specular response. Hair must move and respond to light naturally. Clothing must show believable folds, fabric weight, and motion.

Do not beautify, idealize, stylize, or redesign the reference characters beyond what is necessary to integrate them convincingly into the scene.

PHYSICAL INTEGRATION AND FRAME-TO-FRAME STABILITY

Every replacement must be integrated into the reconstructed footage with consistent physical and optical behavior.

Maintain:

Correct anatomy and body proportions

Correct subject-to-environment scale

Consistent perspective and depth

Accurate occlusion between characters and objects

Correct contact points and weight distribution

Natural foot placement and ground contact

Physically plausible cloth and hair movement

Consistent lighting direction, intensity, and color

Realistic cast shadows and contact shadows

Coherent reflections on glass, mirrors, vehicles, and other reflective surfaces

Natural motion blur consistent with the original movement and camera

Stable identity, wardrobe, accessories, and body proportions across frames

When characters overlap, cross in front of one another, or temporarily disappear behind objects, preserve the correct depth order and identity.

Reconstruct reflections and other visible representations of replaced characters using the assigned reference identity. Never allow the original character to remain visible in a mirror, window, vehicle surface, or background reflection.

No flicker, morphing between identities, temporal warping, inconsistent anatomy, or sudden appearance changes.

STRICT PRIORITY ORDER

When requirements conflict, follow this priority order:

Preserve original performance timing, body motion, facial expression dynamics, and lip-sync.

Preserve the assigned reference character's identity without blending in the original character.
Preserve the original shot timing, camera movement, framing, and spatial choreography.
Reconstruct the environment and integrate all subjects with convincing physical continuity.
Achieve the cinematic early-2000s aesthetic and natural photographic texture.
Resolve conflicts by reconstructing the new character and environment around the original performance, not by altering the performance to accommodate the reconstruction.

FINAL OUTPUT REQUIREMENTS

Deliver one coherent, fully reconstructed cinematic video.

Every original human character must be replaced by its assigned reference character.

Every replaced character must remain visually consistent throughout the entire video.

The original characters' recognizable identities must be completely absent.

The environment must be newly reconstructed and visually distinct while retaining the original video's broad cinematic mood and energy.

The original performance, gestures, facial expressions, choreography, shot timing, and lip-sync must be preserved as faithfully as the source footage allows.

The finished video must feel like a genuine early-2000s-inspired live-action music video starring the assigned reference characters, filmed in a new location, with natural skin, realistic materials, seamless compositing, and professional cinematic image quality.

No superficial face swap. No identity blending. No generic motion. No plastic skin. No recognizable original character appearance.

entries.prompt:
Create a 30-second cute, polished 3D animated short film with a charming family-friendly animation style. Use soft rounded shapes, detailed miniature environments, warm sunlight, expressive character animation, and smooth cinematic camera movements. No photorealism or anime.

CHARACTER:
One adorable small orange-brown squirrel with a large fluffy tail, cream-colored muzzle, tiny rounded ears, bright eyes, a teal work vest, and a little yellow construction helmet. Keep its appearance identical throughout.

SETTING:
A peaceful forest clearing with one large sturdy oak tree. The tree has a thick vertical trunk, several visible branches, and green leaves. The treehouse is built against the same trunk throughout. Keep the background and tree position fixed.

SCENE 1 (0–5s):
The squirrel stands at the base of the oak tree beside a small pile of wooden planks, a hammer, nails, and a short ladder. It looks up at a wooden platform partially attached to the tree, then excitedly picks up a plank and begins working.

SCENE 2 (5–10s):
The squirrel carries one plank up the ladder and places it flat across the platform. It carefully hammers the plank into place. Show the platform gradually becoming a stable wooden floor. The squirrel steps back and proudly inspects it.

SCENE 3 (10–16s):
The squirrel tries to climb the short ladder to reach the higher part of the treehouse, but the ladder ends just below the platform. It looks up, thinks for a moment, then carries a second ladder and securely connects it to the first, creating a taller ladder. It climbs up safely.

SCENE 4 (16–23s):
From the platform, the squirrel attaches wooden wall panels to the existing floor, one panel at a time. It installs a small round window and a red triangular roof. Each piece is carried and physically placed. The treehouse takes shape as a compact, cozy wooden cottage attached to the trunk.

SCENE 5 (23–30s):
The squirrel climbs down, carries a tiny flower pot up the ladder, and places it beside the round window. It opens the little wooden door, revealing a warm, cozy interior with a small glowing lamp. The squirrel sits on the platform beside its finished treehouse, its fluffy tail curled around it. Camera slowly pulls back to reveal the completed treehouse nestled among the oak's green branches.

CONTINUITY:
One squirrel, one oak tree, one treehouse, and one ladder assembly. Keep the treehouse attached to the same trunk and maintain its structure between scenes. The floor is built before walls, walls before roof. All materials must be carried and installed by the squirrel. The ladder remains in the same position. No disappearing planks, floating construction materials, changing tree shapes, duplicate characters, or sudden completed structures.

AUDIO:
Gentle original whimsical instrumental music, forest birds, footsteps on wood, realistic soft hammer taps, ladder movement, and subtle cozy magical chimes. No dialogue or lyrics.
